response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuit_counts), shares AS (SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.race_count, 1.0 * cc.race_count / t.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 / t.circuit_count AS average_share FROM circuit_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT c.circuitId, c.name AS circuit_name, s.race_count, s.race_share, s.race_share - s.average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares s JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = s.circuitId ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average circuit's share is the mean across circuits that have hosted at least one race; circuits with zero races are excluded because they have no rows in races.
